items.title: Jane Bunnett interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 25, 2024
items.q: just down the road from Art Tatum

ctx.x: Yeah. I’ve so enjoyed speaking with you today. It’s great to, you’re not only a wonderful interviewer but the fact that you’re coming at it from knowing about the music and artistically the thought process that we as musicians go through. It’s so interesting always to answer those kind of questions because sometimes we just take it for granted in our own development and musical journey, how you think, you know. So it forces you to think about how you think about what you do.

Yeah also, you can’t see it but on the wall in front of me I have four pages of information about you including your awards and nominations, and the fact that you can share a record display with your band on top of Duke Ellington and just down the road from Art Tatum.
I know. Isn’t that sort of self-gratification. It is. I got this. And then I’ve got some of the great people that —
